confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several third-party cost-of-living sites that broadly agree, though their dates and methods vary (2024 to 2026). Beer and cocktail figures conflict by roughly $1 to $2 across sources. The wine glass anchor is inferred from the local beer price, since no reliable current wine-by-the-glass price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Source sites quoted NPR at roughly 148 per USD. The FX observation was read from a search summary of the RBA daily table and was not re-verified on the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is South Asian tourist-city pricing, anchored on Kathmandu-specific sources. Cross-checks included a cost-of-living index of about 26 on a New York = 100 scale, and the typical Thamel-area price spread between local eateries and tourist-oriented venues.
